verdict.rationale: Luma documents a video generation API: the Dream Machine reference has a createGeneration endpoint with per-endpoint OpenAPI definitions and a Try It panel, and the current Agents API advertises a generation endpoint with Python/JS/TS SDKs. However, the evidence never shows how a developer polls job status or downloads the finished asset, and the reference with the runnable spec is marked legacy. Missing for 10: documented status-polling or retrieval endpoint for finished video assets, documented asset download URLs or callbacks, current (non-legacy) endpoint reference detail, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end submit-and-retrieve flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a video generation job through a documented API and retrieve the finished asset
